description: Use this when the user wants investors in one of their funds reminded to sign the subscription agreement they were already sent — the ones they name, or everyone who has not signed. Starts the reminders. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed reminders, with who is left out and why, for the user to confirm. This call sends nothing.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_remind_to_sign
title: Remind investors to sign
